description: This PHP class 'StrLength' defines a validation rule for string length constraints within a validation framework. It checks if a string's length falls within specified minimum and maximum bounds, considering optional text encoding and inclusivity rules.

classes.name: StrLength
classes.description: A validation rule class that verifies whether a string's length according to specific constraints.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the rule with optional minimum and maximum length values, encoding, and inclusion flag, and validates the logical correctness of max and min values.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks if the input string satisfies the length constraints using helper method to get string length.

methods.name: validateMin
methods.description: Determines if the string length meets the minimum length requirement.

methods.name: validateMax
methods.description: Determines if the string length does not exceed the maximum length requirement.
